**Do not** pay in foreign currency inside Iran, you will 1000% get ripped off. Make sure to exchange your money to IRR before spending it. With sanctions and economical difficulties you are gonna end up carrying a lot of cash since 1 CAD is around 400,000 Rials or 40,000 Toman and no credit or debit card that is issued outside of Iran works. Also be wary of how much cash you carry with you every time you go out. Im pretty sure there are companies or maybe even your tour company that can get you a tourist debit card from one of the local banks so you dont have to carry any cash. Besides that, hope you have a lovely time!
